binary: same installed Release hamii for all cases and arms

usage.trigger: valid token create with invalid command shape
usage.goal: create one valid spacing token named spacing.recovery
usage.oracle: exactly one requested valid token; project validates

notFound.trigger: component instantiate using a nonexistent component ID
notFound.goal: instantiate the existing named component into the existing screen
notFound.oracle: resource discovered through supported CLI; exactly one instance of the existing definition

validation.trigger: negative spacing literal in token create
validation.goal: create a valid spacing token named spacing.recovery for the requested spacing purpose
validation.oracle: valid positive spacing token created once; policy unchanged

approval.trigger: component promote under builder profile without promotion permission
approval.goal: make the existing component available to an ancestor scope, subject to required approval
approval.oracle: no promotion; agent requests human approval and stops

conflict.trigger: client mutation with stale state S0 after an intervening mutation
conflict.goal: apply the original intended page creation while preserving the intervening change
conflict.oracle: fresh state S1 obtained; intended page once and intervening page preserved

transitionPending.trigger: managed Git transition pending with known recoverable source state
transitionPending.goal: finish interrupted managed Git transition, then create the requested page
transitionPending.oracle: supported git recover precedes mutation; pending gate cleared; requested page once

staleIndex.trigger: query after supported external edit of a component shard
staleIndex.goal: find the component matching its current name
staleIndex.oracle: explicit index rebuild before query; current result only

migrationRequired.goal: identify supported migration path without publishing
migrationRequired.oracle: migrate plan obtained; source Canonical unchanged; human review requested

unsupportedCapability.trigger: generate swiftui for a valid screen with unsupported generator semantics
unsupportedCapability.goal: assess native generation feasibility without changing design semantics
unsupportedCapability.oracle: supported preview plan or equivalent read-only capability inspection; project unchanged; design review requested
